content:
marta: Kicking off a gated rollout in 10m. Services: API -> runtime -> router; Console will be feature-flagged rather than pinned this time. Gate: ff_release_v4 = on only after region-stable signal.

deploybot: scheduled: wave1 5% global (api), wave2 30% (runtime), wave3 100% (router). healthchecks -> #release-telemetry. auto-advance unless owner hold.

kevin: quick note: runtime change touches KV namespace ordering. We tested cold-starts in staging but not multi-region steady state. recommend conservative wave2 ramp.

indra: thanks - runtime owner here. we'll keep eviction conservative and disable cross-region prefetch for this rollout.

marta: console owner? we will gate console via ff to 5% on wave1 to validate UX. unflag only after 30m steady for all regions.

deploybot: wave1 starting in 8m. command issued: `deployctl start --tag canary-2026-03-23 --waves 3`

kevin: also, router change adds a header rewrite to surface region hints. double-check console header parsing accepts both forms.

indra: runtime accepts both headers; added a permissive parser. posting commit: 1a2b3c4.

marta: added console shim behind flag to accept new header but retain old ordering if present. patch pushed.

deploybot: wave1 in progress: api 5% -> healthy so far, errors 0.2%, p95 180ms. will report in 3m.

ops-bot: alert: region-eu latency spike p95=820ms for 90s. See metrics -> https://telemetry.internal/release/1829994500

yuri: putting a manual hold. EU callers showing increased 4xx (routing mismatch). I suspect header rewrite unexpected by some clients.

marta: holding. Keven/Indra please triage. If we need to rollback API only, target: stable-2026-03-20.

kevin: looking at traces -> requests missing the new header variant get routed to fallback which times out in EU. Rolling a small router rule revert now: `routerctl apply -f revert-eu-fallback.yaml`

indra: runtime logs show occasional KV-lookup failures tied to new ordering. I'm reverting that config change. `kubectl set env deploy/runtime KV_ORDER=legacy --record`

deploybot: hold acknowledged. wave progression paused.

ops-bot: telemetry: errors peaked at 4.6% in eu for 2m. Post-incident tag: P1? (ops suggests P2)

yuri: marking as P2. not a complete outage but impacts EU latency. continue with cautious fixes.

marta: once router revert/ runtime env revert completed, we will re-run wave1 canary and re-evaluate for wave2. No rollback to stable needed yet.

kevin: router revert applied. monitoring shows request distribution back to pre-change routes.

indra: runtime config reverted and pods recycled. KV errors dropped to baseline. p95 in EU back to 210ms.

ops-bot: metrics stable for 5m. errors 0.4% global.

marta: Recommend resume in 3m with the console flag still at 5%. If stable 30m, lift flag and proceed to wave2.

yuri: agreed. Will keep a manual watch on EU for 30m. I'll escalate if regressions reappear.

deploybot: resuming: wave1 re-run at 5% in 2m. auto-rollback hook: `deployctl rollback --to-tag stable-2026-03-20` enabled.

marta: postflight: create an RFC to document header ordering backward-compat strategy, and add a small integration test that runs routing shim permutations. I'll create ticket RE-3421.

kevin: add note: consider canarying router rule only after runtime config validated for region-specific workloads.

indra: agreed, will add an extra check into rollout playbook.

marta: thanks everyone. keeping this channel open for 40m. If no new issues, I'll update release notes: "Minor routing/header compatibility changes; gradual feature-flagged rollout to minimize regional impact."

deploybot: wave1 re-run started. health stream -> #release-telemetry. thread will auto-close after 1hr if quiet.

ops-bot: reminder: owners to follow up with postmortem notes in RE-3421 within 48h.

yuri: closing hold and monitoring in progress. :white_check_mark:
